anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Temperature rose from 90.363 °C at t=1080 s to 95.415 °C at t=1140 s and 96.034 °C now, departing from the preceding gradual trend.
Buffer differential pressure increased from 1.983 to 3.356 mbar while column differential pressure remained 0.819 mbar and system pressure was 695.765 mbar; this does not identify a specific fault.
Buffer differential pressure partially recovered to 2.515 mbar; distillate and reflux flows recovered from 0.082/0.084 to 0.125/0.164.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol stage and commanded heater powers/setpoints are needed to distinguish an intended transition from an uncommanded process disturbance; independent temperature and buffer-pressure checks would help localize a fault. No composition measurement or target specification is available.
